messages.author: aa8d8a5c39930fde
messages.subject: greek letters not showing (problem with \\ in text)
parts:
knitr+tikz normally works well for me, including inserting latex math equations. But typing greek letters as described in the manual does not work. 

For example

<<sasd,dev='tikz'>>=
qplot(1,1,xlab="$\\theta$")
@

produces the error: Quitting from lines 171-NA: Error : ’\ ’ is an unrecognized escape in" 

Any idea what is going wrong?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] greek letters not showing (problem with \\ in text)
parts:
Well, this sounds like a bug of the tikzDevice package. One workaround
is to use \\\\ in order to write a real \ in TeX, e.g.

library(ggplot2)

x=c(0,1)
D=stack(list("$\\\\theta=0.3$"=dbinom(x,1,0.3),'$\\\\theta=0.5$'=dbinom(x,1,0.5),'$\\\\theta=0.9$'=dbinom(x,1,0.9)))
names(D)=c("mass","theta")
D$x=x
qplot(x, mass, data=D, geom='bar', stat='identity', facets=.~theta,

xlab="$\\theta$",ylab="$p_X(x)$",main='Bernoulli
Distribution Mass Functions')

I do not know why this is the case, and you may want to ask tikzDevice
developers: tikzdev...@lists.r-forge.r-project.org

Regards,
Yihui
